messages.subject: Helpers for community analysis/vegan workshop on Saturday
parts:
Hi all,

This Saturday there's a workshop on on community data analysis and the vegan R package as part of the ESA meeting in Sacramento. Details here: http://eco.confex.com/eco/2014/webprogram/Session9891.html.  They're looking for a helper or two to for the session.  Moderate R skills needed, and a some of familiarity with vegan helpful.  The organizers/instructors are Naupaka Zimmerman (nau...@gmail.com), who taught in the beginner's room at the Software Carpentry workshop in June, and Gavin Simpson (ucf...@gmail.com), one of vegan's authors.  If you're interested in volunteering, get in touch with them.

Noam
